mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real estate sales (HOUST) indicates a strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST showed a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strong supply-side activity, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO showed a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a single month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure, which erodes real returns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) increases by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same quarter, it signals a strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 0.5% QoQ and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in the same quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where GDPC1 increased by more than 0.5% QoQ and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% in the same quarter.
